comparison.lexeme_expansion: union of every declared raw alternative token plus extra_critical_lexemes; no output-derived additions
comparison.boundary_local_reports: report the same alignment restricted to annotated occurrences whose batch word times overlap +/-1 second around each observed cut; whole-run gate remains mandatory
